mapper.select: SELECT s.*, v.booking_days_ahead AS bookingDaysAhead, v.min_booking_minutes AS minBookingMinutes FROM s_reminder_subscription s JOIN s_venue v ON v.id = s.venue_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE s_reminder_subscription s JOIN s_notification n ON n.idempotency_key = CONCAT('alert:opening:', s.id) SET s.opening_notified_at = n.created_at, s.updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.type = 'OPENING' AND s.opening_notified_at IS NULL
UPDATE s_reminder_subscription SET status = 'CANCELLED', updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE s_reminder_subscription s JOIN s_venue v ON v.id = s.venue_id SET s.status = 'EXPIRED', s.updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND TIMESTAMP(s.target_date, s.end_time) <= CONVERT_TZ( DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL v.min_booking_minutes MINUTE), '+00:00', '+08:00')
